metaDescription: Order custom 4 xlarge shirts for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk options with your logo. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Ordering custom shirts in 4 xlarge ensures that every member of your team, regardless of size, receives a professional and comfortable fit. Whether you're outfitting safety managers with durable work shirts or providing marketing staff with branded button-downs, this size accommodates a wider range of body types. Many of our shirts, like the Men's Elemental Coffee Shirt or the Ladies Montauk Henley, are available in 4XL with consistent sizing across styles, making it easy to mix and match for a cohesive uniform program.
